docs.doc_group: 适用性审查（App. E）— 供应链整体
docs.item_cn: 供应链详细描述（进口货物及其部件，含开采/生产/制造的全部阶段）；各实体角色（含发货人/出口商，供应商是否同时为制造商）；按 19 CFR 152.102(g) 披露关联关系；每一生产环节的供应商名单（名称、地址、邮箱、电话）；参与生产各方的宣誓书
docs.item_en: Supply-chain description incl. all stages; roles of each entity (incl. shippers/exporters); related-party disclosure per 19 CFR 152.102(g); supplier list per production step with contact details; affidavits from each entity

docs.doc_group: 适用性审查（App. E）— 货物及部件
docs.item_cn: 采购订单；全部供应商与二级供应商发票；装箱单；BOM；原产地证；付款记录；卖方库存记录（含码头/仓库收据）；运输记录（舱单、海运/空运/卡车提单）；买方库存记录；全部供应商与二级供应商的发票与收据；进出口记录
docs.item_en: Purchase orders; invoices for all suppliers and sub-suppliers; packing list; bill of materials; certificates of origin; payment records; seller's inventory records incl. dock/warehouse receipts; shipping records incl. manifests and bills of lading; buyer's inventory records; import/export records

docs.doc_group: 适用性审查（App. E）— 开采/生产/制造方
docs.item_cn: 原料的同类凭证；开采/生产/制造记录（能把原料追溯到货物；生产订单；工厂产能报告；进口商/下游客户/第三方的工厂实地核查报告；投入量与产出量匹配的证据）；其他证明未使用强迫劳动的证据——审计须为突击式、由能审查 ILO 11 项强迫劳动指标的独立第三方进行；财务/环境审计或不针对 ILO 指标的审计一般不被认可
docs.item_en: Same evidence for raw materials; mining/production records (traceability, production orders, capacity reports, site-visit reports, input-output volume match); other evidence — audits must be unannounced third-party audits against the ILO 11 indicators; financial/environmental audits not considered sufficient

docs.item_cn: 尽职调查体系（与供应商/利益相关方的接触、供应链绘图与风险评估、禁止强迫劳动并针对中国政府劳动力计划的供应商行为准则、员工培训、监督、整改或终止、独立验证、公开报告）；供应链管理措施（内控；文件须属于含经审计财务报表的运营/会计系统）；证明中国境内货物未用强迫劳动（供应链图、各实体工人工资与人均产量、招工与自愿性内控、针对 ILO 指标的可信审计与整改）
docs.item_en: Due-diligence system (supplier engagement; mapping and risk assessment; code of conduct addressing PRC government labor schemes; training; monitoring; remediation/termination; independent verification; public reporting); supply-chain management measures; evidence for China-origin goods (supply-chain map; wage and per-worker output data; recruitment controls; credible ILO-indicator audits)

docs.item_cn: 两条路径：适用性审查（货物不在 UFLPA 范围：无新疆成分、无实体清单关联）vs 例外申请（承认在范围，以"清楚且令人信服的证据"反驳）；UFLPA/CAATSA 扣留：30 天内经 Forced Labor Portal 答复或申请延期（延期须在 30 天内提出，最多两次、合计不超过 90 个日历日）；WRO 扣留：3 个月内证明不受 WRO 约束、出口或销毁，否则视为排除；排除后 180 天内可提 19 U.S.C. 1514 抗议；例外获准后 CBP 30 天内报告国会；含 BCI 的材料用双方括号 [[BCI]] 标出；外文文件须附翻译
docs.item_en: Applicability review vs exception request; UFLPA/CAATSA: 30 days via Forced Labor Portal, max two extensions totalling ≤90 calendar days; WRO: three months; protest within 180 days of exclusion; BCI in double brackets; translations required

docs.item_cn: 全部制造步骤的流程图并区分每一步由哪家公司执行（含表面涂装）；每种原料的原产地证或制造商宣誓书（写明实体名称与开采、冶炼、制造的具体地点）；原料发票、采购订单与付款凭证、生产记录、出口单据；铝锭/铝棒的生产工艺细节；进一步加工成型材、卷材、线材等产品的地点
docs.item_en: Flowcharts of all manufacturing steps by company; certificates of origin or manufacturer's affidavits naming entity and location where each material is mined smelted and manufactured; raw-material invoices POs proof of payment production and export records; ingot/billet process details; location of further manufacture into extrusions coils wire etc.

docs.item_cn: 从原料（棉、羊毛、合成纤维）→纺纱→织造/针织、染整→裁剪缝制→出口的全链条文件，证明各阶段（含全部投入与部件）未用强迫劳动；分阶段的生产流程说明与各设施的地理位置、角色（建议附流程图与产区地图）；直接或经中间商参与各步骤的全部实体及其佐证（PO、合同、发票、付款、认证、工厂审计等），并标注用以识别非直接交易上游实体的商业记录
docs.item_en: End-to-end documentation from fiber through spinning fabric dyeing/finishing garment assembly and export; stage-by-stage process breakdown with facility locations (flow chart and maps recommended); all entities at each step with supporting records and citations to the records identifying indirect upstream entities

docs.item_cn: 盐等原料采购→氯碱工艺→包装→出口的全流程记录；分步骤（盐水制备、电解、烧碱生产）的工艺说明与各设施地理位置；PO、认证、工厂审计等证明全部实体（含中间商）参与情况的记录
docs.item_en: Records of the caustic soda process from salt sourcing through chlor-alkali process packaging and export; process summary (brine preparation electrolysis) with facility locations; POs certifications facility audits verifying all entities incl. intermediaries

docs.item_cn: 采矿→精炼→冶炼→出口的全链条文件；分阶段（采矿、冶炼、精炼、出口包装）说明与地点；每种原料的原产地证或制造商宣誓书（实体名称与开采、选矿（浮选/浸出）、冶炼、精炼（火法/电解）、铸造成阳极/阴极/铸锭、再加热、制成长材/板带箔/管材的具体地点）；半成品的后续加工（冷加工、退火、表面处理、质检）；证明各实体（含间接）角色的其他记录
docs.item_en: Full chain from mining refining smelting to export; stage breakdown with locations; certificates of origin or affidavits naming entity and location for mining concentration smelting refining casting reheating and production of long/flat/tubular products; downstream processing steps; supporting records for all entities incl. indirect

docs.item_cn: 从棉包级原产地到成品的全供应链文件（含日常经营记录如 PO、付款记录）；生产流程图与产区地图，逐步骤编号并对应编号的佐证文件；各步骤全部实体及用以识别非直接交易上游实体的商业记录引用
docs.item_en: Comprehensive documentation from the cotton at bale level to the finished product; flow chart and regional maps with numbered steps and numbered supporting documents; all entities per step with citations to business records identifying indirect upstream entities

docs.item_cn: 采矿→化学加工→电池级精炼→出口的完整可追溯记录；从矿石提取到化学加工、精炼、出口的物料流向说明及各阶段地理信息；合同、认证、交易记录等证明全部公司（含间接参与）参与情况
docs.item_en: Fully traceable records for mining chemical processing battery-grade refining and export; outline of material movement with geographic details per stage; contracts certifications transaction records confirming all companies incl. indirect

docs.item_cn: 制造、加工或出口 PVC 产品的全部公司及每种原料来源（追溯至可能的强迫劳动）；从乙烯/氯等原料到成品的全供应链日常记录（PO、发票、付款、运输）；生产流程图与产区地图（PVC 地板须含 PVC 树脂、碳酸钙等全部层），逐步编号并提供热压层压的制造记录
docs.item_en: All companies making processing or exporting PVC and the source of each material; ordinary-course records from ethylene/chlorine sourcing to finished product; flow chart and maps incl. all PVC flooring layers (resin calcium carbonate) with numbered steps and lamination records

docs.item_cn: 种植、采收、干燥、加工、出口的全链条记录；分步骤（种植、晒干/机械干燥、分选、包装）说明与地点；发票、认证、农场记录等证明全部参与方（含间接）
docs.item_en: Records tracing cultivation harvesting drying processing and export; process description with locations; invoices certifications farm records verifying all parties incl. indirect

docs.item_cn: 捕捞、加工、出口的全部公司记录，证明各环节发生地点并追溯至可能的强迫劳动来源（被标记的捕捞作业或实体清单加工厂）；简明流程图（捕捞/养殖地、加工地、包装与出口地）；日常记录（PO、付款、运输、捕捞证书等）覆盖从捕捞/养殖到成品
docs.item_en: Records of all companies catching processing or exporting; simple chart of where caught/farmed processed packed and exported; ordinary-course records incl. catch certificates from harvest/farming to finished product

docs.doc_group: 硅基产品含多晶硅（App. A）
docs.item_cn: 证明参与制造、加工或出口的全部实体及每种原料原产国（追溯至疑似强迫劳动来源）的交易与供应链记录；流程图标出采购与生产每一步及各原料产区（从石英岩产地→硅基产品/多晶硅生产设施→下游产品设施）；各步骤全部实体名单及识别非直接交易上游方的商业记录引用；提示：工厂同时采购新疆内外硅料的货物有被扣留风险——难以证明未被新疆硅料替换或混合
docs.item_en: Transaction and supply-chain records showing all entities and the country of origin of each material back to the suspected source; flow chart from quartzite location through polysilicon facilities to downstream facilities; list of all entities per step with citations; warning that factories sourcing both XUAR and non-XUAR polysilicon risk detention due to commingling

docs.item_cn: 全部制造步骤流程图并区分执行公司；每种原料的原产地证或制造商宣誓书（实体名称与开采、加工、高炉/转炉/电弧炉冶炼、连铸、再加热、热轧、制成长材/板材的具体地点）；后续加工（冷却、冷轧、退火、酸洗、机加工、磨抛、平整等）；原料发票、PO 与付款、生产记录、出口单据；铁进一步制成半成品/钢/不锈钢的地点；提单等追踪投入物直至出口美国的单据
docs.item_en: Flowcharts by company; certificates of origin or affidavits naming entity and location for mining processing BF/BOF/EAF refining continuous casting reheating hot rolling and long/flat products; downstream processing; raw-material invoices POs payment production and export records; location of further manufacture; bills of lading tracing inputs through export to the U.S.

docs.item_cn: 按商品、品种、地点、收获日期分配批号等追溯文件，证明番茄种子/番茄/番茄制品的原产地；识别加工厂（含母公司）及供应种子/番茄的庄园；从种子到成品、从农场到运往美国的全部生产步骤记录；各步骤全部实体名单及识别非直接交易上游方的商业记录引用
docs.item_en: Traceability documents (lot codes by commodity variety location harvest date) showing the origin of seeds tomatoes or products; identify the processing facility incl. parent company and the estate supplying seeds/tomatoes; records for all steps from seed to finished product and farm to shipment; list of all entities with citations

fcc_covered.scope_cn: 华为技术有限公司（含子公司及关联公司，如 Huawei Device、海思等）生产或提供的电信设备，及其提供或使用该设备提供的电信/视频监控服务
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Verbatim: "Telecommunications equipment produced or provided by Huawei Technologies Company, including telecommunications or video surveillance services produced or provided by such entity or using such equipment." Footnote: applies only to equipment/services capable of the functions in Secure Networks Act sec. 2(b)(2)(A)-(C). "Produced by" = substantial responsibility for or control over design, development, manufacture or assembly (FCC 25-71). Covered modular transmitters (2.903(a)(1)-(2)) and, from 2026-10-13, logic-bearing hardware components (e.g., Huawei/HiSilicon SoCs) taint any host device (2.903(b)).
fcc_covered.hts_hint: 8517.62 (routers/switches/modems/RAN units); 8517.61 (base stations); 8517.13/8517.14 (handsets); 8517.79/8517.71 (modules, antennas, parts); 8471 (laptops/tablets); 8528.52/8528.72 (displays/TVs); 8525.89 (cameras); 8504.40 (Huawei inverters/PSUs if communications-capable); 8542.31 (HiSilicon ICs as components)
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: No new FCC equipment authorization (certification or SDoC) since 2023-02-06 (47 CFR 2.903); equipment otherwise exempt from authorization also barred (2.903(c)(3)). Previously authorized models: continued importation and marketing PROHIBITED since 2026-07-16 (DA 26-635 under 47 CFR 2.939(e)). Import requires a valid, un-limited authorization or a 2.1204 condition; FCC states covered equipment "could not be imported or marketed" (FCC 26-50).
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 自2023-02-06起不得获得任何新的FCC设备认证（Certification或SDoC，47 CFR 2.903），免于认证的设备同样禁止；此前已认证型号自2026-07-16起禁止继续进口和营销（DA 26-635，47 CFR 2.939(e)）；进口需持有未被限制的有效认证或符合2.1204进口条件，FCC明确受管制设备不得进口或营销。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: FCC 22-84 did NOT revoke pre-2022-11-11 grants (Secure Equipment Act sec. 2(a)(3)(A)). BUT DA 26-635 (91 FR 41023) limited all pre-existing authorizations of equipment added to the Covered List in 2024 or earlier: importation and marketing prohibited from 2026-07-16; consumer use of lawfully purchased devices continues. No permissive changes/modifications allowed (2.932(f), 2.1043(b) as amended by FCC 25-71/26-50); spare-parts/replacement exemption expressly rejected.
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: None for new authorizations. Consumer continued use only. Do not rely on 2.1204(a)(3) testing (4,000 units), (a)(4) trade show (400), (a)(7) personal use (3) or (a)(11) pre-sale (12,000) conditions for covered equipment: 2.903(c)(3) extends the prohibition to equipment exempt from authorization and FCC 26-50 revised 2.1204(a)(2) to require compliance with FCC "administrative" regulations (TBD_ no FCC KDB expressly addresses (a)(3) for covered equipment).
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: 新认证无任何豁免；仅允许消费者继续使用已合法购买的设备；不要依赖2.1204(a)(3)测试4,000台/(a)(4)展会400台/(a)(7)自用3台/(a)(11)预售12,000台等进口条件进口受管制设备。
fcc_covered.effective: Covered List 2021-03-12; authorization ban 2023-02-06 (88 FR 7592); import/marketing ban on previously authorized models 2026-07-16

fcc_covered.scope_cn: 海能达通信股份有限公司（含子公司及关联公司，如 Hytera US、Teltronic、Norsat）生产或提供的视频监控和电信设备，限于用于公共安全、政府设施安保、关键基础设施实体安全监控及其他国家安全目的的范围
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Verbatim: "Video surveillance and telecommunications equipment produced or provided by Hytera Communications Corporation, to the extent it is used for the purpose of public safety, security of government facilities, physical security surveillance of critical infrastructure, and other national security purposes, including telecommunications or video surveillance services produced or provided by such entity or using such equipment." FCC 22-84 treatment: because the use-based scope cannot be policed at authorization stage, ALL new authorizations of Hytera telecom/video-surveillance equipment are prohibited until the FCC approves a Hytera plan ensuring the equipment is not marketed/sold for those purposes (interim freeze from 2022-11; no plan approved as of 2026-09-14 [S]).
fcc_covered.hts_hint: 8525.60 (DMR/TETRA two-way radios, repeaters); 8517.62 (PoC/LTE radios, dispatch gateways); 8525.89 (body-worn cameras); 8517.79/8529.90 (parts); 8517.61 (TETRA base stations)
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: No new FCC equipment authorization of any Hytera telecom or video-surveillance equipment since 2023-02-06 (conditional/use-based prohibition applied as a full freeze pending an FCC-approved plan). Previously authorized models: since 2026-07-16 importation/marketing prohibited ONLY to the extent the equipment is for the enumerated purposes (public safety, government-facility security, other national security); the "physical security surveillance of critical infrastructure" prong of the import/marketing ban is SUSPENDED until the FCC adopts a critical-infrastructure definition (FCC 26-50 codified one in 47 CFR 1.50001 effective 2026-10-13 — lifting of suspension TBD_).
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 自2023-02-06起，海能达的电信/视频监控设备一律不得获得新FCC认证（在FCC批准其“不用于上述目的”的计划之前全面冻结）；已认证型号自2026-07-16起，仅在用于公共安全、政府设施安保、其他国家安全目的时禁止进口和营销；“关键基础设施实体安全监控”这一项暂缓执行，直至FCC定义生效（FCC 26-50于2026-10-13生效，是否解除暂缓待定）。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: Pre-rule grants not revoked by FCC 22-84. DA 26-635 limits prior authorizations only for the enumerated uses (critical-infrastructure prong suspended). Non-covered uses (e.g., consumer/commercial radios not for those purposes) may continue to be imported/marketed under existing FCC IDs [S]; no new models, no permissive changes.
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: Importer may continue to import previously authorized models for non-enumerated uses (must document end use); no exemption for new authorizations. D.C. Circuit (Hikvision USA v. FCC, 2024-04-02) upheld the freeze but vacated the prior "critical infrastructure" definition.

fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Verbatim entry: "Foreign-produced power inverters, except power inverters which have been granted a Conditional Approval by DoW or DHS." (added 2026-07-28; updated 2026-08-20). Original 2026-07-28 definition: bi-directional device converting DC to AC or AC to DC (microinverters, string, central, hybrid) that "contain components enabling remote communication, control, sensing, data collection, or monitoring" via Wi-Fi, cellular, Bluetooth or similar. Revised 2026-08-20 (DA 26-870): covers only devices that change DC power to AC power, including bidirectional devices, that are "utility-interactive" inverters as defined in UL 1741 sections 2.1.23 and 2.1.52 (intended for use in parallel with an electric utility), AND that "contain, or are designed, equipped, or configured to accept, a component that enables remote communication, control, sensing, data-collection, or monitoring through Ethernet, Wi-Fi, cellular, Bluetooth, or other similar connections, whether wired or wireless." "Foreign-produced" = does not qualify as "domestic end product" under 48 CFR 25.101(a). Excluded: inverters eligible for the 26 U.S.C. 45X advanced manufacturing production credit for domestic production, or meeting the 48 CFR 25.101(a) domestic end product test (>65% domestic component cost 2024-2028; 75% from 2029). Non-utility-interactive (off-grid/stand-alone) inverters no longer covered.
fcc_covered.hts_hint: 8504.40.95 / 8504.40.85 (static converters: string/central/hybrid/micro inverters); 8501.80 / 8501.72 (AC PV modules with integrated microinverter); 8507.60 (hybrid inverter-battery systems, if classified as battery); 8504.40 (bidirectional EV/V2G inverters if utility-interactive)
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: No new FCC equipment authorization for foreign-produced utility-interactive, communications-capable inverters since 2026-07-28 (47 CFR 2.903); definition narrowed effective 2026-08-20. Grid-tied inverters with Wi-Fi/cellular/Ethernet (or a slot designed to accept a comms module) are RF devices requiring authorization; new models cannot be authorized or imported. Conditional Approval applications accepted until 2028-01-01 (DoW or DHS review; DHS for inverters).
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 自2026-07-28起（定义于2026-08-20缩窄），外国生产的、UL 1741定义的并网互动型且含有（或设计可接入）远程通信模块的逆变器新型号不得获得FCC认证，无法进口；有条件批准申请截止2028-01-01。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: Previously authorized inverter models remain valid unless FCC later revokes/limits them (not within DA 26-635); may continue to be imported/sold. Hardware permissive changes prohibited; software/firmware Class I & II changes waived by DA 26-789 (2026-07-28) through 2029-01-01. Consumers may keep using devices.
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: (1) 45X-eligible domestically produced inverters; (2) Buy American domestic end products (48 CFR 25.101(a), 65%/75% domestic component cost); (3) non-utility-interactive (off-grid) inverters and inverters with no comms capability and no provision to accept one are outside the definition; (4) DoW/DHS Conditional Approval (conditional-approvals@fcc.gov; deadline 2028-01-01); (5) previously authorized models.
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: (1) 符合45X先进制造税收抵免的美国产逆变器；(2) 《购买美国货法》国内最终产品（国产部件成本>65%，2029年起75%）；(3) 非并网/离网逆变器及无通信能力且无预留通信接口者不在范围内；(4) 国防部/国土安全部有条件批准（截止2028-01-01）；(5) 此前已认证型号。
fcc_covered.effective: Covered List 2026-07-28; narrowed 2026-08-20; waiver to 2029-01-01; conditional approval window closes 2028-01-01

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: Foreign-produced advanced robotic devices (mobile ground robots incl. autonomous mobile robots, humanoids, quadrupeds), except those granted Conditional Approval by DoW
fcc_covered.scope_cn: 在外国生产的先进机器人设备（地面移动机器人，含自主移动机器人、人形机器人、四足机器人），获国防部有条件批准者除外
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Verbatim entry: "Foreign-produced advanced robotic devices, except advanced robotic devices which have been granted a Conditional Approval by DoW." Definition (NSD 2026-07-27, as summarized by Wiley/Skadden/Sidley [S] — verbatim appendix TBD_): a mechanical device, including autonomous mobile robots, humanoid robots and quadrupeds, that (1) is capable of locomotion, obstacle avoidance, navigation or movement on the ground; (2) operates at a distance from a human operator/supervisor based on commands or in response to sensor data; (3) weighs more than 4.4 lbs (incl. docking station); and (4) contains an environmental sensor, a network-connectivity component (≥200 kbps) and software controlling autonomous navigation/movement or remote command-and-control (incl. AI/ML weights [S]). Exclusions: connected vehicles (15 CFR 791.301); rail-only vehicles; UAS (47 CFR 88.5); unmanned underwater vehicles; FDA-regulated medical devices (21 U.S.C. 360c) incl. surgical robots, prostheses, mobility-assistive devices; fixed/stationary industrial or medical robots (SCARA, articulating, Cartesian, delta arms). "Foreign-produced" = not a "domestic end product" under 48 CFR 25.101(a). Consumer robots >4.4 lbs with Wi-Fi/LiDAR (robot vacuums, robotic lawn mowers, pool robots, delivery robots) fall within the literal definition — product-specific analysis required [S].
fcc_covered.hts_hint: 8479.50.00 (industrial robots nesoi — but fixed arms excluded); 8479.89 (other machines: AMRs, humanoids, quadrupeds); 8508.11 (robot vacuum cleaners); 8433.11 (robotic lawn mowers); 8428.90/8427 (autonomous material-handling/AGVs); 8709 (works trucks, autonomous); 9503 (toy robots — only if >4.4 lbs and networked); 8525.89/9031 (sensor modules as components)
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: No new FCC equipment authorization for foreign-produced advanced robotic devices since 2026-07-28 (47 CFR 2.903) — every Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/cellular-connected mobile robot is an RF device needing certification, so new models cannot be authorized or imported. Conditional Approval: DoW only; applications close 2028-01-01; require BOM, ownership (≥5% beneficial owners), country of origin of design/software, and quantified U.S. onshoring plan with quarterly reports.
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 自2026-07-28起，外国生产的先进机器人设备（含联网扫地机器人、割草机器人、四足/人形机器人等，重量>4.4磅）新型号不得获得FCC认证，无法进口；仅国防部可给予有条件批准，申请截止2028-01-01。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: Previously authorized models remain valid unless later revoked/limited (not within DA 26-635); may continue to be imported/sold; hardware permissive changes prohibited; software/firmware Class I & II changes waived by DA 26-789 through 2029-01-01.
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: Buy American domestic end product (48 CFR 25.101(a), >65%/75% domestic component cost); listed exclusions (connected vehicles, rail, UAS, UUVs, FDA medical devices, fixed industrial/medical robots); devices ≤4.4 lbs or without ≥200 kbps connectivity; DoW Conditional Approval; previously authorized models; federal government use.
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: 《购买美国货法》国内最终产品；明确排除项（联网汽车、轨道车辆、无人机、水下无人载具、FDA医疗器械、固定式工业/医疗机械臂）；≤4.4磅或无≥200kbps联网能力的设备；国防部有条件批准；此前已认证型号。
fcc_covered.effective: Covered List 2026-07-28; waiver to 2029-01-01; conditional approval window closes 2028-01-01
fcc_covered.source: DA 26-786 (2026-07-28; NSD 2026-07-27); DA 26-789 (2026-07-28); DOC-423682A1 (2026-07-28); FCC FAQ page fcc.gov/covered-list-faqs-robots-inverters (inaccessible to fetch — 403)

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: 47 CFR 2.903 — prohibition on authorization of equipment on the Covered List (Secure Equipment Act of 2021 implementation)
fcc_covered.scope_cn: 47 CFR 2.903——禁止对“受管制清单”设备进行设备认证（《2021安全设备法》实施规则）
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Verbatim 2.903(a): "All equipment on the Covered List, as established pursuant to § 1.50002 of this chapter, is prohibited from obtaining an equipment authorization under this subpart." 2.903(c): applies to equipment subject to certification, to SDoC, and to "equipment exempt from equipment authorization". 2.903(d)-(e): Covered List entities must file contact info of subsidiaries (>50% voting/de facto control) and affiliates (≥10% equity) by 2023-03-08 and within 30 days of changes. Also added applicant attestations (2.911(d), 2.1033) that equipment is not covered and that the applicant is not a Covered List entity.
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: Covered equipment cannot obtain certification or SDoC; therefore cannot be legally imported (47 CFR 2.1203/2.1204(a)(1)) or marketed (47 CFR 2.803). Applies to all Covered List entries, present and future, automatically upon listing.
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 受管制设备不得获得认证或SDoC，因此不能合法进口（47 CFR 2.1203/2.1204(a)(1)）或营销（47 CFR 2.803）；对现有及未来所有清单条目自动适用。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: Grants made before 2022-11-11 were NOT reviewed/revoked by this Order (Secure Equipment Act sec. 2(a)(3)(A)); FCC reserved future revocation authority — exercised via 2.939(e) (FCC 25-71) and DA 26-635 (2026).
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: None for covered equipment.
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: 无。
fcc_covered.effective: Adopted 2022-11-11; released 2022-11-25; 88 FR 7592 (2023-02-06), effective 2023-02-06 (some PRA-dependent attestation provisions later)

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: "Bad labs" rule — test labs, TCBs and lab accreditation bodies owned/controlled (≥10% equity/voting, or direction/subsidy) by prohibited entities (Covered List entities, BIS Entity List/MEU, DoD 1260H, Treasury NS-CMIC, UFLPA Entity List, NDAA sec. 5949 companies, or foreign adversary governments) barred from the equipment authorization program
fcc_covered.scope_cn: “不良实验室”规则——由受禁实体（受管制清单实体、BIS实体清单/军事最终用户、国防部1260H清单、财政部NS-CMIC、UFLPA实体清单、NDAA第5949条企业或外国对手政府）拥有/控制（≥10%股权或表决权，或受其指挥/资助）的测试实验室、TCB和实验室认可机构不得参与FCC设备认证
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Rule: FCC will not recognize, and will withdraw recognition of, any TCB, test lab or accreditation body "owned by, controlled by, or subject to the direction of" a prohibited entity or foreign adversary government (47 CFR 2.948, 2.960, 2.962 amended; ownership threshold 10%). Test reports from de-recognized labs cannot support new or pending certification or SDoC. Enforcement: 2025-09-08 notices of intent to withdraw recognition for 7 PRC labs (Chongqing Academy of ICT; CQC Internet of Vehicles; CVC Testing; CVC Testing Shanghai; TTL CAICT; TUV Rheinland-CCIC Ningbo; UL-CCIC) plus expirations/denials (CESI Guangzhou; CAICT; Shanghai Institute of Measurement and Testing Technology; CCIC Southern Testing); 2025-09-26 denials (CCIC-CSA International Certification; Industrial Internet Innovation Center (Shanghai); State Radio Monitoring Center; Reliability Laboratory–New H3C); withdrawal orders 2025-10-24 (5 labs).
fcc_covered.hts_hint: All RF device HTS — affects importers whose suppliers used PRC state-linked labs for FCC test reports
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: Importers must confirm the FCC test lab and TCB on the grant/SDoC file are currently FCC-recognized (OET list); reports from prohibited labs cannot be used for new applications or permissive changes. Previously granted authorizations were not automatically invalidated by FCC 25-27 (TBD_ FCC has not announced mass revocation).
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 进口商需确认认证文件中的测试实验室和TCB仍在FCC认可名单内；受禁实验室的报告不能用于新申请或许可变更；FCC 25-27未自动撤销此前已授予的认证（待观察）。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: Not revoked; but new applications/permissive changes must use recognized labs.
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: None (Second R&O FCC 26-28, 2026-04-30, adds fast-track PAG for equipment tested in "Trusted Test Labs" in U.S./MRA partners).
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: 无豁免（FCC 26-28为在美国/MRA伙伴国“可信实验室”测试的设备提供快速审批通道）。
fcc_covered.effective: Adopted 2025-05-22; released 2025-05-27; 90 FR 38045 (2025-08-07); effective 2025-09-08 (PRA-dependent parts later)

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: Second R&O FCC 25-71 — covered modular transmitters and host devices; "produced by" definition; prohibition on modifications/permissive changes to covered equipment; new 47 CFR 2.939(e) procedure to limit existing authorizations (bar continued import/marketing while allowing use)
fcc_covered.scope_cn: 第二次报告与命令FCC 25-71——受管制模块化发射器及其宿主设备；“produced by（生产）”的定义；禁止对受管制设备进行改动/许可变更；新增47 CFR 2.939(e)程序（限制既有认证：禁止继续进口和营销，允许继续使用）
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: 2.903(a)(1)-(2), (b): equipment on the Covered List includes modular transmitters (certified or certifiable under 15.212) and "All equipment that incorporates equipment meeting the descriptions in paragraph (a)(1) or (2) of this section is prohibited from obtaining an equipment authorization" — regardless of whether the module was previously authorized. "Produced by": substantial responsibility for or control over any major stage — design, development, manufacture or assembly — totality of circumstances (captures white-label/OEM). Modifications: all permissive-change filings must attest equipment is not covered; permissive changes to covered equipment prohibited. 2.1204(a)(1) amended: import allowed only under an authorization "that has not been limited through the procedures described in § 2.939(e)".
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: Any host device (of any brand) that incorporates a Huawei/ZTE (or other covered-entity) radio module cannot be authorized after 2025-12-26; importers must verify module vendor on FCC ID/BOM. Authorizations limited under 2.939(e) no longer satisfy the 2.1204(a)(1) import condition.
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 2025-12-26起，任何品牌的宿主设备若内含华为/中兴等受管制实体的射频模块均不得认证；进口商需核查模块供应商；被2.939(e)限制的认证不再满足2.1204(a)(1)进口条件。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: Existing grants untouched unless limited under 2.939(e) (first applied by DA 26-635, effective 2026-07-16).
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: None.
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: 无。

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: DA 26-635 — prohibition on continued importation and marketing of previously authorized covered equipment added to the Covered List in 2024 or earlier (Huawei, ZTE, Hytera, Hikvision, Dahua, equipment integrating Kaspersky software)
fcc_covered.scope_cn: DA 26-635——禁止继续进口和营销2024年及以前列入清单的、此前已获认证的受管制设备（华为、中兴、海能达、海康威视、大华、集成卡巴斯基软件的设备）
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Verbatim SUMMARY: "the Public Safety and Homeland Security Bureau (PSHSB) and the Office of Engineering and Technology (OET) prohibit the continued importation and marketing of certain previously authorized equipment that has been determined to pose an unacceptable risk ... acting pursuant to § 2.939 of the Federal Communications Commission's rules, PSHSB and OET apply such prohibitions to communications equipment added to the Covered List in 2024 or earlier." Use-based entries (Hytera/Hikvision/Dahua): prohibition applies only to the enumerated purposes; critical-infrastructure prong suspended pending definition. Excludes UAS, routers, inverters, robots (post-2024 entries). Spare-parts/replacement exemption rejected.
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: From 2026-07-16 importers may not import or market (sell, offer, ship, distribute) previously authorized Huawei/ZTE/Kaspersky-integrated equipment at all, nor Hytera/Hikvision/Dahua equipment for public-safety/government-facility/national-security purposes. Existing inventory cannot be sold in the U.S. (no sell-off period granted).
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 2026-07-16起不得进口或营销此前已认证的华为/中兴/集成卡巴斯基设备，也不得为公共安全/政府设施/国家安全用途进口或营销海能达/海康/大华设备；库存不得在美销售（未给予清库期）。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: Authorizations remain on file but are "limited" under 2.939(e): consumers may continue to use lawfully purchased equipment.
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: Consumer continued use; non-enumerated uses for Hytera/Hikvision/Dahua; critical-infrastructure prong suspended (TBD_ after 2026-10-13).
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: 仅允许消费者继续使用；海能达/海康/大华的非列举用途；关键基础设施项暂缓。

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: Third R&O FCC 26-50 — devices incorporating a "logic-bearing hardware component" produced by a Covered List entity cannot be authorized (47 CFR 2.903(b)(2)); Covered List entities barred from SDoC and permissive-change procedures for any modification (2.932(f), 2.1043)
fcc_covered.scope_cn: 第三次报告与命令FCC 26-50——含有受管制清单实体生产的“逻辑硬件部件”的设备不得认证（47 CFR 2.903(b)(2)）；受管制实体不得使用SDoC或许可变更程序进行任何改动
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Verbatim 2.902 definition: "Logic-bearing hardware component. Any device, system, module, sub-assembly, integrated circuit, or other physical component that generates and uses timing signals or pulses at a rate in excess of 9,000 pulses (cycles) per second and uses digital techniques; inclusive of telephone equipment that uses digital techniques or any device, system, module, sub-assembly, integrated circuit, or other physical component that generates and uses radio frequency energy for the purpose of performing data processing functions, such as electronic computations, operations, transformations, recording, filing, sorting, storage, retrieval, or transfer." Verbatim 2.903(b)(2): prohibited if the device incorporates "A logic-bearing hardware component produced by an entity identified on the Covered List ... if—had such entity produced the device itself, rather than just a component—the device would be prohibited from receiving authorization under paragraph (a) of this section." Applies to named-entity entries (Huawei/HiSilicon, ZTE, Hytera, Hikvision, Dahua, Kaspersky-integrated); production-location-based entries (UAS, routers, inverters, robots) are exempt from the component rule. Purely mechanical/structural parts, passive components, power-only parts and bare motors excluded. Prospective only; applications pending before the effective date proceed under old rules.
fcc_covered.hts_hint: 8542.31/8542.32/8542.33 (SoCs, processors, memory controllers from HiSilicon etc.); 8517.79 (modules); host devices: 8525.89 (IP cameras with HiSilicon SoC), 8528.72 (TVs), 8517.62, 8471, 8521.90
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: From 2026-10-13, any new device (any brand, any origin) containing a HiSilicon/Huawei, ZTE, Hikvision, Dahua or Hytera chip/module/sub-assembly cannot be certified or SDoC'd, hence cannot be imported for sale. Importers should obtain component-lineage attestations from suppliers (FCC says no new investigation duty beyond existing compliance, but applicant attestations are required and false attestations trigger streamlined revocation).
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 2026-10-13起，任何新设备（不论品牌/产地）若含有海思/华为、中兴、海康、大华、海能达生产的芯片、模块或子组件，不得认证，从而不得进口销售；进口商应向供应商索取部件来源声明。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: Previously authorized equipment unaffected (prospective only).
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: Applications filed and pending before 2026-10-13; production-location-based Covered List categories (UAS, routers, inverters, robots) not treated as "entities" for this rule; non-logic components.
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: 2026-10-13前已提交待审的申请；按产地列入的类别（无人机、路由器、逆变器、机器人）不适用本部件规则；非逻辑部件。
fcc_covered.source: FCC 26-50 (ET Docket 21-232); 91 FR 57798; fact sheet DOC-422746A1 (2026-07-01, FCC-CIRC2607-05); news release DOC-423291A1 (2026-07-22)

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: Third R&O FCC 26-50 — online marketplaces (15 U.S.C. 45f(f)(4)) must display a valid FCC ID at the online point of sale for devices subject to certification; listing + fulfilment/warehousing/order-processing = "marketing" under 47 CFR 2.803(a)(1)
fcc_covered.scope_cn: 第三次报告与命令FCC 26-50——在线市场（15 U.S.C. 45f(f)(4)定义）必须在在线销售点展示有效FCC ID；“上架+仓储/履约/订单处理”构成47 CFR 2.803(a)(1)项下的“营销”
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: Verbatim 2.803(c)(1): "An online marketplace that markets a radiofrequency device subject to certification, or that offers for sale a radiofrequency device subject to certification on behalf of a third-party seller and has physical access to or takes title to that device, must display a valid and accurate FCC ID, as set forth in § 2.925, for the device at the online point of sale." (compliance by 2027-03-01). 2.803(c)(2): marketplace hosting third-party sellers without physical access/title must display a valid FCC ID; not liable for seller-supplied inaccuracy if it verified the FCC ID against the EAS database and required seller certification (compliance by 2027-06-01). Exempt: listings published before the effective date until substantively amended; non-"high-volume" third-party sellers (15 U.S.C. 45f(f)(6)); used devices.
fcc_covered.hts_hint: All certified RF devices sold online (8517, 8525, 8471, 8528, 8508, 8806, 8504.40 etc.)
fcc_covered.prohibition_en: Importers/e-commerce sellers must have a valid FCC ID for every certified device listed; marketplaces will delist products without one; marketplaces performing fulfilment are themselves "marketing" and liable under 2.803 for unauthorized/covered equipment without a willfulness requirement.
fcc_covered.prohibition_cn: 进口商/电商卖家上架的每台需认证设备必须有有效FCC ID，否则平台将下架；提供履约服务的平台本身构成“营销”，对未认证/受管制设备承担责任。
fcc_covered.existing_authorizations: N/A
fcc_covered.exemptions_en: Pre-existing listings until amended; low-volume third-party sellers; used devices; SDoC-only devices (no FCC ID) — SDoC registration proposed in Third FNPRM.
fcc_covered.exemptions_cn: 生效前已发布且未修改的列表；非大宗第三方卖家；二手设备；仅SDoC设备（无FCC ID，注册制在FNPRM中提议）。
fcc_covered.effective: Rule effective 2026-10-13; compliance dates 2027-03-01 (para. (c)(1)) and 2027-06-01 (para. (c)(2))

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: PROPOSED — connected vehicle technologies (VCS hardware; ADS and completed connected vehicles; VCS hardware with integrated covered software) designed/developed/manufactured/supplied by persons owned by, controlled by or subject to the jurisdiction/direction of the PRC or Russia (Commerce ICTS rule 15 CFR part 791 subpart D, 90 FR 5360)
fcc_covered.scope_cn: 拟议（未生效）——联网汽车技术（车辆联网系统VCS硬件、自动驾驶系统ADS及整车、集成受管制软件的VCS硬件），由受中国或俄罗斯管辖/控制的主体设计、开发、制造或供应（商务部ICTS规则15 CFR 791 D分部）
fcc_covered.equipment_scope_en: DA 25-418 (2025-05-23) sought comment on two proposed entries: (1) "Automated driving systems and completed connected vehicles designed, developed, manufactured, or supplied by persons owned by, controlled by, or subject to the jurisdiction or direction of" the PRC or Russia; (2) VCS hardware from such persons "intended to be included within a completed connected vehicle in the United States; or VCS hardware with integrated covered software". Comments closed 2025-06-27. DA 25-644 (2025-07-23) said the Commission was still evaluating. No Covered List addition found as of 2026-09-14 (TBD_).

fcc_covered.producer_or_scope_en: PROPOSED — Third FNPRM (FCC 26-50): cut 47 CFR 2.1204(a)(3) testing/evaluation import allowance from 4,000 to 40 units; bar devices with ANY component from a Covered List entity (or rebuttable presumption); mandatory HBOM/SBOM; 10-year term limits on authorizations; U.S.-based liable party for every certification; SDoC device registration with FCC-assigned ID; codify "produced in a foreign country" (FAR domestic end product), "UAS critical components" and "routers"; white-labeling disclosure; bifurcate Covered List; FCC logo restrictions; streamlined revocation; submarine-cable scope
